name: hupai-interaction-editorial
label: 虎派互动数据编辑线稿
preamble: Refined editorial line icons for a warm high-end eyewear portfolio. Uniform medium-thin outline, rounded caps and joins, no fill, no isolated circles or dot decorations, calm geometric construction, flat front-facing view.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area 72%; generous equal padding; optical sizing
construction.stroke: uniform 1.75 units, rounded caps and joins
construction.detail_budget: one interaction metaphor and no more than four elements
construction.color_rule: deep brass primary line with optional shorter muted-brass secondary line
construction.shared_parts: reuse one canonical heart, bookmark, speech-tail, and arrowhead geometry
construction.motif: a short echo line integrated into the main silhouette, never a detached circle
construction.forbidden: isolated circles, small dots, labels, numbers, shadows, black fills
